purpose: Quantify effective biological-unit retention and model sensitivity to the positive mapped-protein qualification threshold in the paper-attached 141-subject cohort without imputation.

eligibility.rank_target: finite strictly positive source value mapped to a frozen R3 sequence feature
eligibility.source_na_policy: retain and report AUTHOR_NA; exclude from rank; no imputation
eligibility.source_zero_policy: retain and report AUTHOR_EXPLICIT_ZERO; exclude from rank; no imputation
eligibility.threshold_unit: mapped rank-eligible canonical target rows per subject-particle batch
eligibility.rank_denominator: all finite strictly positive source rows within the source-defined batch, before model scoring

uncertainty.interval: percentile 95% cluster bootstrap over retained biological units

claim_boundary: This is an author-run missingness and threshold sensitivity on a paper-attached biological cohort. It does not establish an independent laboratory, protected lockbox, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
